title.en: Chapter 34 — Fogg Equal to the Occasion

book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: وصلوا نيويورك، وركضوا عالميناء بأسرع ما يقدروا.
sentences.en: They reached New York, and rushed to the port as fast as they could.

sentences.ar: بس الباخرة الي لأوروبا كانت طلعت قبلهم بشوية بس.
sentences.en: But the ship to Europe had left just a little before them.

sentences.ar: مرة تانية، ضيّعوا الباخرة بفرق دقايق.
sentences.en: Once again, they missed the ship by a few minutes.

sentences.ar: باسبارتو حس بالذنب، لأنه بسببه صار كل هالتأخير.
sentences.en: Passepartout felt guilty, because all this delay was on his account.

sentences.ar: بس فوغ ما استسلم، وراح يدوّر على أي مركب تاني.
sentences.en: But Fogg didn't give up, and went to look for any other ship.

sentences.ar: لقى مركب صغير اسمه هنريتّا، بس صاحبه ما بدّه يروح لإنجلترا.
sentences.en: He found a small ship called the Henrietta, but its owner didn't want to go to England.

sentences.ar: فوغ عرض عليه مصاري كتيرة، بس الكابتن رفض.
sentences.en: Fogg offered him a lot of money, but the captain refused.

sentences.ar: فوغ اتفق معه إنه بس ياخدهم لفرنسا، وركبوا المركب.
sentences.en: Fogg agreed with him only to take them to France, and they boarded the ship.
